title: After the Hanshin J.F.: Child Prodigy

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I… I won…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Nishino Flower's so fast! She's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: She seriously is a prodigy! Way to go, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I… I did it! I won!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So please, don't worry so much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'd rather see you smile. So… could you do that for me, please?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you… Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, that person just—
choice_data_list: Let's go rest in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Ehehe.)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's her trainer? Now there's someone with a sharp eye for runners!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: They were praising Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Winning sure feels nice. It was a lot of work, but Trainer looked so happy.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (And thanks to Trainer's guidance and care, I don't feel as tired as I did after my debut race.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Oh.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I was wondering why I became race-ready so early…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (But maybe it's because it's happening now that…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right! I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I've decided what I want my next race to be.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to come back here again, when the cherry blossoms are in bloom!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yup. I want to run in the Oka Sho and take on the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara tour comprises three G1 races that can only be run in one's classic year—the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's proven today that she can handle G1 races, and her running shows a lot of promise for her classic year. In that case…
choice_data_list: Okay! The Oka Sho it is!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we decide to take on the Triple Tiara by running in its first race—the Oka Sho! However, there's something I want to know.
choice_data_list: Was this your plan from the start?
Was this your plan from the start?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Many Umamusume who run in the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies go on to run in the Triple Tiara tour. It's only natural to want to challenge higher-level races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking back, deciding to run the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies was a bold choice for her. Maybe I'm only thinking about this because she's never voiced what her dream is, but…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… Well…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …I'll tell you after the Oka Sho!
